bullets.text: old journal line surfaced — a memory's brightness is the experience plus all the time since. the years do half the painting.
duck at shinsho-ji above muroto harbor. stone steps, fishing boats. the steering jizo never asks who's at the helm.
cutting a sentence down to the boat and the water. everything else was rigging.
overcast and even. the kind of grey that doesn't ask anything back.
the boat comes in either way. the helm was a rumor.
